label: Acute Hospital
description: Whole acute provider operating model: flow, care delivery, performance, safety, finance and capacity.

label: Elective Care
description: Planned outpatient, diagnostic, pre-operative, admitted and non-admitted treatment pathways.

label: Emergency Care
description: Urgent and emergency care including ED attendances, ambulance arrivals, streaming, admissions and discharges.

label: Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
description: Same-day assessment and treatment intended to avoid admission where clinically appropriate.

label: Inpatient Areas
description: Admitted ward-based care, bed occupancy, ward moves, discharge planning and length of stay.

label: Daycases
description: Planned admitted care where the patient is discharged on the same day.

label: Cancer
description: Cancer referrals, diagnostics, treatment pathways, waiting time standards and outcomes.

label: Diagnostics
description: Imaging, pathology, physiological measurement, endoscopy and other diagnostic services.

label: Outpatients
description: Referral, booking, attendance, follow-up, PIFU, DNA and clinic utilisation.

label: Theatres
description: Theatre scheduling, utilisation, cancellations, lists, anaesthetics and recovery.

label: Critical Care
description: ICU/HDU capacity, occupancy, organ support, step-down and specialist critical care activity.

label: Maternity
description: Antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal care, births, safety and outcomes.

label: Paediatrics
description: Children and young people's emergency, elective, inpatient and outpatient care.

label: Pharmacy and Medicines
description: Medicines optimisation, dispensing, prescribing, stock, antimicrobials and high-cost drugs.

label: Workforce
description: Staffing, rostering, vacancies, sickness, bank/agency usage, productivity and skill mix.

label: Finance
description: Income, expenditure, cost improvement, service-line reporting and efficiency.

label: Quality and Safety
description: Incidents, harms, mortality, complaints, outcomes, clinical audit and patient experience.

label: Patient Flow
description: Cross-hospital flow from arrival/referral through admission, transfer, discharge and follow-up.

label: Referral to Treatment (RTT)
description: 18-week elective referral-to-treatment pathway and waiting list management.

label: Cancer Patient Tracking List
description: Cancer pathway tracking from referral through diagnosis and treatment.

label: Urgent and Emergency Care Flow
description: Ambulance/ED/SDEC/admission/discharge flow and escalation.

label: Executive Performance Dashboard
description: High-level trust performance view across access, quality, workforce, finance and productivity.

label: Elective PTL Dashboard
description: Waiting list, RTT, booking, validation, long wait and capacity view for elective care.

label: UEC Daily Sitrep / Flow Dashboard
description: Daily urgent care demand, ED performance, bed state, admissions, discharges and escalation.

label: SDEC Performance Dashboard
description: SDEC activity, conversion, turnaround, admission avoidance and specialty usage.

label: Bed Occupancy and Flow Dashboard
description: Bed occupancy, stranded patients, criteria-to-reside, length of stay and discharge profile.

label: Theatre Utilisation Dashboard
description: Session utilisation, late starts, early finishes, cancellations and productivity.

label: Cancer Waiting Times Dashboard
description: Cancer standards, PTL, breaches, tumour site performance and diagnostic/treatment intervals.

label: Diagnostics Waiting Times Dashboard
description: DM01-style waits, modality demand, capacity, utilisation and breaches.

label: Outpatient Utilisation Dashboard
description: Clinic utilisation, DNA, cancellations, follow-up backlog, PIFU and advice/guidance.

label: Workforce Productivity Dashboard
description: Roster fill, sickness, vacancy, agency, bank and productivity indicators.

label: Quality and Safety Dashboard
description: Incidents, harms, mortality, complaints, infection control and patient experience.

label: ED 4-hour standard
description: Proportion of ED attendances admitted/transferred/discharged within four hours.

label: Ambulance handover delay
description: Time from ambulance arrival to patient handover.

label: RTT within 18 weeks
description: Proportion of incomplete RTT pathways waiting under 18 weeks.

label: Elective long waits
description: Patients waiting beyond threshold such as 52/65/78 weeks depending standard.

label: Diagnostics within 6 weeks
description: Proportion of diagnostic waits within six weeks.

label: Cancer faster diagnosis standard
description: Patients told whether cancer is diagnosed or ruled out within 28 days.

label: Cancer 62-day treatment standard
description: Urgent suspected cancer referral to first definitive treatment within 62 days.

label: Bed occupancy
description: Occupied beds as a percentage of available beds.

label: Length of stay
description: Duration from admission to discharge, often analysed by spell, ward, specialty or cohort.

label: Stranded / super-stranded patients
description: Patients with long stays above local/national thresholds.

label: Theatre utilisation
description: Used theatre time as proportion of planned/available time.

label: DNA rate
description: Outpatient appointments where patient did not attend.

label: Sickness absence
description: Workforce sickness absence rate.

label: Electronic Patient Record
description: Core clinical and administrative patient record.

label: Patient Administration System
description: Demographics, referrals, appointments, admissions, discharges and waiting lists.

label: Emergency Department System
description: ED attendance, triage, treatment, decisions and discharge/admission timestamps.

label: Pathology LIMS
description: Pathology requests, specimens, results and turnaround times.

label: RIS/PACS
description: Radiology requests, imaging events, reports and modality information.

label: Theatre System
description: Theatre lists, sessions, procedures, timings and cancellations.

label: Cancer Tracking System
description: Cancer pathway tracking, milestones, MDT and treatment data.

label: E-rostering System
description: Rostered shifts, staffing, absence, bank and agency usage.

label: Incident Reporting System
description: Patient safety incidents, harms, risks and learning actions.

label: Admissions Discharges Transfers dataset
description: Patient movement events across wards, beds and spells.

label: Outpatient appointments dataset
description: Outpatient referrals, bookings, attendances, cancellations and clinic outcomes.

label: RTT pathway dataset
description: Referral-to-treatment clocks, statuses, waits, pauses and outcomes.

label: ED attendances dataset
description: ED arrivals, triage, timestamps, investigations, outcomes and breach reasons.

label: Diagnostics dataset
description: Diagnostic waits, tests, modalities, requests, results and reporting dates.

label: Cancer pathway dataset
description: Cancer referral, tracking, diagnosis, treatment and standard breach data.

label: Theatre activity dataset
description: Theatre session, list, case, timing and cancellation data.

label: Workforce dataset
description: Roster, ESR/workforce, absence, vacancy and temporary staffing data.

label: National RTT standards
description: National elective access reporting and 18-week standard.

label: DM01 diagnostics return
description: National diagnostic waiting times and activity return.

label: Cancer Waiting Times standards
description: National cancer waiting time standards and reporting.

label: UEC standards and sitreps
description: Urgent and emergency care performance standards and operational returns.

label: Executive Team
description: Board and executive users of performance and assurance information.

label: Divisional Management Teams
description: Operational leadership users managing specialties, services and recovery plans.

label: Operational Managers
description: Day-to-day service managers using actionable operational intelligence.

label: Clinical Leads
description: Clinical leaders using data for quality, safety, capacity and pathway improvement.

label: Analytics Team
description: Data and analytics professionals building, assuring and explaining information products.
